title: Validate ingestion and refresh on real agent histories
description:
**Intent:** Prove the store against reality: run ingestion (BOTSPY-a48fb1) and incremental refresh (BOTSPY-d5b2c4) over real session histories from all five agents — Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Grok Bot, Antigravity — on this machine, not fixtures. Fixtures stay the specification surface; this task is the reality check.

**What to verify:** discovery counts match the real sources; ingestion is strictly read-only (digests before/after, the importer-contract proof); lossless round-trip on real transcripts (weird encodings, huge sessions, partial files surface as skip counters, never errors); refresh re-ingests only changed sessions and prunes vanished ones with an honest per-outcome report; FTS search finds known real messages; the MiniLM embedder ingests real text without error and a paraphrase of a real message ranks its session first (semantic spot-check).

**Acceptance:** a recorded run log on this task (per-source counts, skip counters, refresh report, digests unchanged); any adapter bug found is filed as a bug under the owning adapter epic and this task notes it; no product code changes unless a bug is confirmed. Run against read-only copies of the sources — never mutate agent data.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
**Real-history validation run, 2026-10-03 (this machine, macOS arm64):**

**Discovery:** claude_code 64 sessions; codex 0 (bug — see BOTSPY-81143b: the adapter's SELECT fails on the real `state_5.sqlite` schema and the error is swallowed, hiding 233 real threads); cursor 0 (this machine has the CLI-era ~/.cursor layout, no `state.vscdb` — root missing, reported honestly); grok_bot 0 (not installed); antigravity 0 (present, no sessions).

**Ingestion (with the real all-MiniLM-L6-v2 embedder):** 62 new sessions from claude_code in ~44 min (embedding dominates). The 64→62 gap is correct behavior, not loss: 2 duplicate summaries deduped by first-report-wins. 4 sessions with zero messages ingest as empty sessions.

**Read-only proof:** 1846 files under ~/.claude/projects; 1844 byte-identical (mtime unchanged); the only 2 files written during the 44-minute ingest window are live concurrent-writer files (`bridge-pointer.json` and one actively-appended transcript whose tail still parses as JSONL) — not the adapter. ~/.codex note: any WAL-mode SQLite reader (including read-only opens) touches the `-shm` sidecar — the DB itself and rollouts are untouched; the codex adapter reading its index DB directly rather than through a snapshot is part of BOTSPY-81143b.

**Refresh:** 0 new / 0 updated / 62 unchanged / 0 pruned in **1.7 s** (vs 44 min initial ingest) — unchanged sessions are never re-mined, exactly as specified.

**Query spot-checks:** FTS "tokio" → 95 sensible code hits. Semantic self-query (a real message's own text) ranks its own session first, score 0.8255 over the real corpus. Round-trip: real sessions open losslessly (4583- and 3339-message sessions). The store records `all-MiniLM-L6-v2` in meta.

**Bugs filed:** BOTSPY-81143b (codex schema drift / silent zero).

**Verdict:** ingestion, dedup, refresh, and both search faces hold on real histories; the only real-history failure is the codex adapter's schema drift, filed separately.
